lines: The short road to Śiva sheds powder, eve-rite, field-claim —
worship stays, and any ground will do.
sanskrit_cite: atha saṃkṣiptadīkṣeyaṃ śivatāpattidocyate | na rajo nādhivāso@tra na bhūkṣetraparigrahaḥ | yatra tatra pradeśe tu pūjayitvā guruḥ śivam

lines: He walks the path inwardly, mind-footed to the far shore of things,
and wakes the birth-freed by whatever road he takes.
sanskrit_cite: adhvānaṃ manasā dhyātvā dīkṣayettattvapāragaḥ | jananādivihīnāṃ tu yena yenādhvanā guruḥ

lines: Steep him in Śiva-mood alone, and draw all down to the single stone;
then speak the Mother-word: the stain lifts now.
sanskrit_cite: kuryātsa ekatattvāntāṃ śivabhāvaikabhāvitaḥ | parāmantrastato@syeti tattvaṃ saṃśodhayāmyatha

lines: Seal each station with the fire-word, feed the flame its full due;
what holds for one spell holds for all — or keep the old telling.
sanskrit_cite: svāheti pratitattvaṃ syācchuddhe pūrṇāhutiṃ kṣipet | evaṃ mantrāntaraiḥ kuryātsamastairathavoktavat

lines: Wombed in Parā, sealed with the fire-word, crowned with the first:
count hundreds, count thousands — but let power do the counting.
sanskrit_cite: parāsaṃpuṭitaṃ nāma svāhāntaṃ prathamāntakam | śataṃ sahasraṃ sāṣṭaṃ vā tena śaktyaiva homayet

lines: Then the ripe word crowns the flawless highest working,
sung in every book by the Great Lord's mouth.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ pūrṇeti saṃśodhyahīnamuttamamīdṛśam | dīkṣākarmoditaṃ tatra tatra śāstre maheśinā

lines: Letter-pairs of the Mothers, station by station — or the seed-syllable whole:
one law runs through every spell.
sanskrit_cite: pratyekaṃ mātṛkāyugmavarṇaistattvāni śodhayet | yadi vā piṇḍamantreṇa sarvamantreṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ

lines: Only the long-practiced, self-dissolved-in-that, may shorten the way —
the short road opens to ripeness alone.
sanskrit_cite: yathā yathā ca svabhyastajñānastanmayatātmakaḥ | gurustathā tathā kuryāt saṃkṣiptaṃ karma nānyathā

lines: The old Tantra allows: hold the all-pervading though the rite be small;
cut the outer flourish, keep the inner flood.
sanskrit_cite: śrībrahmayāmale coktaṃ saṃkṣipte@pi hi bhāvayet | vyāptiṃ sarvādhvasāmānyāṃ kiṃtu yāge na vistaraḥ

lines: 'Not yet one,' he thinks — let him gather the scattered sticks anyway;
the ordered steps will kindle oneness.
sanskrit_cite: atanmayībhūtamiti vikṣiptaṃ karma sandadhat | kramāttādātmyametīti vikṣiptaṃ vidhimācaret

lines: So runs the short rule, grace-spoken by Śiva,
inked in Dīkṣottara, in Kiraṇa, in every school.
sanskrit_cite: saṃkṣipto vidhirukto@yaṃ kṛpayā yaḥ śivoditaḥ | dīkṣottare kairaṇe ca tatra tatrāpi śāsane
